name: How a ticket is built (the phase chain)
summary: The data flow of the /build-feature phase chain: ticket-supervisor takes a wired ticket (handed over from the AC lifecycle) and dispatches each phase agent at depth 1 in order — architect-review, then test-writer (TDD red), then the coders (make it green), then change-scope-reviewer, pr-reviewer, the AC coverage gates, and finally commit and pull-request. The handoff medium between phases is the ticket file itself plus each agent's sign-off comment: a phase reads the ticket + the prior sign-offs, does its work, and appends its own sign-off with status ok | blocker | handoff, which is what unblocks the next phase. When the PR merges, control returns to the AC lifecycle's 'complete' step, which marks the AC done.

steps.label: Supervisor dispatches phases
steps.human: ticket-supervisor reads the ticket's `agents:` map and drives the ticket through its phase agents in natural order, spawning the next `needed` agent at depth 1 and routing on the sign-off status it parses back (ok / handoff / blocker / question).

steps.label: Architect review (blast radius)
steps.human: architect-review classifies the change's structural impact (small vs large) and either writes an inline architectural note or escalates to an Opus sub-agent, so downstream coders know the blast radius before they touch code.

steps.label: Test-writer (TDD red)
steps.human: test-writer reads the ticket's `## Test Requirements`, writes the specified failing test stubs, runs them to confirm they are RED, and records a structured red_baseline in its sign-off — the contract the coders must turn green.

steps.label: Coders make it green
steps.human: python-coder / frontend-coder / sql-coder implement against the red baseline, editing only the ticket's files_touched, and run the suite until every red_baseline test moves to green.

steps.label: Change-scope review
steps.human: change-scope-reviewer compares the staged diff against the ticket's files_touched / out_of_scope and flags any unexpected file as soft / hard / ambiguous before the diff is reviewed for quality.

steps.label: PR self-review
steps.human: pr-reviewer runs the review-pr toolkit over the working diff, keeps only high-confidence findings, and escalates a medium-confidence cluster to Opus — a quality gate before the coverage gates.

steps.label: AC coverage + fulfillment gates
steps.human: ac-validator confirms every AC has concrete implementation + test evidence in the diff, and ac-fulfillment-gate verifies (and auto-fixes) the AC store's work_status / implemented_by / covered_by fields before the commit lock.

steps.label: Gated commit
steps.human: the commit agent shows the planned message + file list, commits under the worktree commit-phase lock, and on a pre-commit hook failure runs the precommit-autofix loop and retries once.

steps.label: Open the pull request
steps.human: the pull-request agent drafts the title + body from the branch's commits, opens (or reuses) the PR, and resolves any merge conflict via conflict-resolver — when the PR merges, control returns to the AC lifecycle's 'complete' step, which marks the AC done.

branches.label: Blocker → adjudication ladder
branches.condition: a phase agent signs off with status: blocker
branches.human: when a phase returns a blocker, ticket-supervisor climbs the failure-adjudication ladder from building-epics — mechanical retry, then cross-agent rework, then brainstorm-lead, then halt — with hard retry caps, instead of proceeding to the next phase.

acceptance_scenarios.given: a wired ticket handed over from the AC lifecycle
acceptance_scenarios.then: each needed phase agent is dispatched at depth 1 in natural order and routed on its sign-off status

acceptance_scenarios.given: a ticket with a non-empty test_requirements block
acceptance_scenarios.then: failing test stubs and a red_baseline are produced for the coders to turn green

acceptance_scenarios.given: a red baseline handed over by test-writer
acceptance_scenarios.then: the production diff turns every red_baseline test green without touching files outside files_touched

acceptance_scenarios.when: the AC coverage + fulfillment gates run
acceptance_scenarios.then: every AC has implementation + test evidence and the AC store fields are made accurate before commit

acceptance_scenarios.given: a committed change on the feature branch
acceptance_scenarios.then: a PR is opened (or reused) and, on merge, the AC lifecycle marks the AC done

acceptance_scenarios.given: a phase agent that returns a blocker
acceptance_scenarios.then: the failure climbs the retry → cross-agent → brainstorm-lead → halt ladder instead of advancing the chain

provenance.note: Real data-flow of the /build-feature phase chain (dispatch → architect → test → code → scope → review → ac-gate → commit → pr) with the agent + produces/consumes handoff contract on each step. Continues from leafcutter/ac-lifecycle's 'generate' (Ticket wired) and returns to its 'complete' step on merge.
